entries.023db4f6c4d10be5: A holding company in Ishikawa Prefecture whose main business is commercial printing such as flyers and direct mail, and which also engages in book publishing and mail-order sales.
entries.75d06407a69587f5: This business publishes and sells books and produces and sells teaching materials. In the table of business contents, Suzuki Shuppan Co., Ltd. and Aruba Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate, are classified under this business. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥684 million (down 5.0% from the prior year). Management's analysis explains that revenue fell in both the publishing business and the kindergarten and childcare business. The segment recorded a loss of ¥118 million (the prior year was a loss of ¥129 million).
entries.7b12898bf0659f79: This business conducts mail-order sales of beauty foods, health supplements and similar products. In the table of business contents, the company classified under this business is Sasaoka Yakuhin Tsuhan Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥41 million (down 24.8% from the prior year), the smallest of the three reportable segments. The segment recorded a loss of ¥19 million (the prior year was a loss of ¥37 million). In the employee information in the securities report, the number of employees for this business is printed as "–".
entries.7f72ec231dd8c542: Production and sales of teaching materials
entries.e24e5e5bc34e568d: Promotional printed materials (flyers, free papers, catalogs, brochures, etc.)
entries.e43d1578e39cd3f5: Business printed materials (envelopes, slips, forms, etc.)
entries.f80a7369ecc3cf98: This business produces and sells promotional printed materials such as flyers, free papers, catalogs and brochures, direct mail such as postcards and letters, sales promotion items such as POP and posters, and business printed materials such as envelopes, slips and forms. The company also manufactures and sells special labels and stickers, plans and produces digital content, produces designs, and develops, manufactures and sells FA (factory automation) equipment. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥7,753 million (down 0.9% from the prior year), accounting for the majority of the company's total revenue of ¥8,478 million and making this its core business. In July 2025, Uēbu Co., Ltd. became a subsidiary and joined this business. The segment recorded a loss of ¥158 million (the prior year was a profit of ¥286 million).
